description: Search Google Hotels for a destination and stay dates. Returns one row per property with nightly price, stay total with taxes and fees, star class, rating, review count, deal label, and amenities.

check_in.description: One or more check in dates, YYYY-MM-DD, up to 330 days ahead. Each date is its own search. Empty: 14 days from today.

check_out.description: Optional. YYYY-MM-DD. Works with one check in date only; for several dates use nights.

dedupe.description: true (default): a property already returned for the same dates in this run is skipped and not charged.

destinations.description: Cities, areas, or landmarks, one per line, for example Miami, Paris 1st arrondissement, or near Times Square. The actor searches "hotels in <destination>". A destination that already says hotels, resorts, hostels, or vacation rentals is sent as written. From Clay, put the column inside a one item list.

hotels_only.description: true: keep only properties Google gives a star class, and drop vacation rentals and unclassified properties (free). Default false.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_hotels_per_search.description: 1 to 40. Default 20. Google Hotels shows about 18 to 20 properties on its first page, and this actor reads that page only.

nights.description: Length of each stay, 1 to 30. Default 2. Ignored when check_out is set.

priced_only.description: true: leave out properties Google shows with no price for your dates. Default false, which returns them as free rows.

name: get_google_hotels_prices
title: Get Google Hotels prices
